name: Varangian Guards
headerMeta: Golden era · Melee infantry · special · 290 leadership · Seasonal (S11: Helheim)
pitch: A dual-form axe and shield bruiser that wins extended fights through ability chaining and punishes enemies in tight spaces with wide AoE swings. Weak to cavalry charges and ranged pressure if caught out of formation.

veterancy.label: Top line
veterancy.body: 5 points top; capstone unlocks Axes of the North (+15% dmg to infantry, renames unit).

veterancy.label: Bottom line
veterancy.body: Rest points mid and top-of-mid tier.

battleRole.positioning: No positioning guidance in sources — treat as flexible line/flank role. Avoid extended exposure to ranged units, especially tier-5 archers. {2}
battleRole.formation: Default F1 (dispersed): each model engages the nearest target independently, reducing AoE vulnerability. {2} Shield-wall (specialized): models plant and hold, auto-face attackers from behind (unreliable vs fast targets or long-range), generate rage while holding. {2}
battleRole.tips: Choke-point specialist: 10–20 enemies per axe swing in alleyways, tower stairwells, corner fights. {2} Activate ability with no enemies nearby for movement-speed bonus (useful for repositioning). {2} First ability is strong defensive block/bash (X-V cycling, reduced stamina); use both ability charges before engaging ranged. {2}

cards.name: Pike-type (braced)
cards.why: actively step into brace + block state, then trigger second ability once brace window ends

controls.notes: 1 (Raging Onslaught) switches to axes. {1} X-move in; 3 and 2 are abilities. {1} V between spell steps adds one auto-attack. {1} Second ability (axe-spin) forces overextension, switches from defensive bash/block state. {2} Passive 'Great Sweep' (area spin-attack) becomes available once second ability activates; re-trigger the ability to refresh cooldown and sweep again — keeps the unit fighting continuously without cooldown idle. {2} Ability activation with no enemies nearby grants movement bonus for repositioning. {2} Pike rotation (V in stance) auto-faces all models to the nearest enemy, nearly doubling contact points. {2}
